title: Perception Is Enough, at the Right Scale: Scale-Adaptive Token Pruning for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.31954v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models must process continuous streams of visual observations, and the resulting computational cost limits real-time robotic control. Token pruning reduces this cost, but a fixed semantic scale of perceptual representation can overlook information needed at different stages of manipulation. We show that perceptual semantics can guide effective token selection without relying on internal attention when the selection scale adapts to the scene's evolving semantic structure. Based on this observation, we introduce TauPrune-VLA, a training-free method that controls the scale of the retained perceptual representation through a single perception temperature $\tau$. To adapt this scale as manipulation proceeds, TauPrune-VLA updates $\tau$ online using trends in perceptual semantics, with robot-state changes and action magnitude regulating the adjustment strength. translated_title: 恰当尺度下的感知已足够：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的尺度自适应Token剪枝
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型必须处理连续的视觉观测流，由此产生的计算成本限制了实时机器人控制。Token剪枝可以降低这一成本，但固定语义尺度的感知表示可能会遗漏操作不同阶段所需的信息。我们证明，当选择尺度能够适应场景不断演化的语义结构时，感知语义可以在不依赖内部注意力的情况下引导有效的token选择。基于这一观察，我们提出了TauPrune-VLA，这是一种免训练方法，通过单一的感知温度参数τ来控制所保留感知表示的尺度。为了在操作过程中自适应调整该尺度，TauPrune-VLA利用感知语义的变化趋势在线更新τ，并以机器人状态变化和动作幅度来调节调整强度。虽然这些语义在操作过程中不断演化……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出免训练的TauPrune-VLA方法，通过单一感知温度参数τ并借助感知语义趋势、机器人状态变化和动作幅度在线自适应调节token剪枝的语义尺度，从而降低VLA模型的计算成本并支持实时机器人控制。
en_tdlr: TauPrune-VLA is a training-free, scale-adaptive token pruning method that uses a single perception temperature, updated online via perceptual semantics trends, robot-state changes, and action magnitude, to reduce the computational cost of vision-language-action models for real-time robotic control.
